# PolyPop sub-actions

## Trigger alert

Makes PolyPop play a WebSocket Alert, with values you choose. Handy for on-screen alerts and effects.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Alert name** | The name of the alert you made in PolyPop's WebSocket source, exactly as you typed it there. |
| **Variables** | Values to pass into the alert, one per line as name=value, like "user=%user%". Each name appears in PolyPop as <name>. Leave empty for none. |

**Variables it adds**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%polypopClients%` | How many PolyPop plugins received the alert |

<small>Type id: `polypop.triggerAlert`</small>
